oracle_scope: True historical record and first position selected by researcher only
findings: Observed positional content remains decodable after reexecution and encoding.
Class-imbalanced diagnostic readers had understated digit readability.
Same-digit-order perturbations remain visible; weak effects do not establish content erasure.
Observed-successor pairing improves shallow conditional readability; same-time pairing is better at deeper layers.
Researcher-selected related-record readers are not the body retrieval/decoder; actual selection and prediction delivery remain to verify.
